title: Changeling Dice Roller
description: A dice roller for Changeling: The Dreaming 20th (or any World of Darkness game). Roll a pool of d10s against a difficulty with willpower, bonus successes, nightmare dice and a specialty. The result card in chat has a difficulty slider, so the player who rolled or the GM can fix a wrong difficulty and the successes are worked out again without rerolling, and buttons to re-roll or explode 10s onto the same card. Cards are coloured with the roller's player colour.
